visualReview.acceptedScope: Distinct surveyed low-building envelopes with recessed glazing, pale frames and blue lower panels, replacing smeared photographic walls. Roofs and courtyard opening retained.
remainingLimitations: Opening positions, subdivisions, colours and recess dimensions are inferred from source projections, not measured facade detail.
Floating source chimney near x=200,z=-67 and stray courtyard triangles remain visible.
Courtyard ground, roof imagery and nearby untreated buildings retain coarse photographic detail and baked shadows.
Existing ordinary dirt structures remain protected and obscure some views.
Night lighting and reflection-buffer edges remain approximate; interiors are outside scope.
